text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day after the Fan Fest, Gold City
says she
wants to talk to me about
something after
practice.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Listen, I... I finally figured it out.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I didn't become "empty," it's that I didn't have anything from the get-go.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I entered the Hanshin J.F. to live up to 
expectations. Then I chose the Classic
Triple Crown because I didn't want to do
as my manager
said.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You know what you call that? Being a
stupid
rebellious teenager. I just do the
opposite of what
I'm told.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I tricked myself into thinking I chose
running for
myself, but I didn't.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I became a model and behaved how others
wanted me to. Then I chose to run
and behave
how others didn't want me
to.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I thought those were two different
things. But
really, they were two sides of
the same coin.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I let the voices of others dictate my
choices. I
couldn't make any on my own.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
A sad, hollow doll. That was the real
Gold City all
along.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
And now, I don't even have that
rebellious spirit
in me anymore.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
No wonder I can't give an answer to why
I run.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: What're ya racing for?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: So yeah... no point in running anymore.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I've lost it all. I have nothing now.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: There is no "real me."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Everything I was chasing, everything I
was so
excited to finally get and make
mine—it was all
fluff.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
And to think I kept telling myself I was
going to
prove who I really was to
everyone... What a joke.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
God, I'm such a loser. Such a freaking
loser.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: ...Then, are you going to stop run...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The first three years of her career are
very important indeed. But if she wants
to run again,
she can do so whenever
and wherever she wants.
choice_data_list: Even if you don't run, your future...
Even if you don't run, your future...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All she'd be sacrificing is this moment...
right here
and now.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...You're right.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure my manager would make me
into the
most popular model out there.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
And you... well, you'd probably end up
training some other runner, but I'm sure
you wouldn't mind
if I stopped by for fun
every now and then.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
And my fans... even if I stop running,
they'll follow
me down another path.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I can't say it. I just can't say "I quit."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...I have to do this.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...See you after the race.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I could quit and still live out my best
life. It'd be a
lot easier, that's for sure.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
God knows I've been in the trenches
when races didn't go my way. I literally
have nothing but
painful memories... So
why?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Why can't I say "I quit"?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: I'm sure you'll understand once yo...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I drag Gold City, in her bewilderment,
back to
the track. She looks a tad
anxious...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Everything I've got? But...
choice_data_list: Try running with all your might!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: O-okay, geez, no need to yell...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Sigh... What is Trainer thinking?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold City starts running. At first, she's
just going
through the motions, but
soon...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... Hey, how long are you going to make me run for?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Screw off! Are you even watching? I am running!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Known to her many fans as Pretty
City..."
"You're so pretty when you run!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"You looked empty."
"I can't believe a
model can run like that!"
"Pretty..."
"Pretty..." "Pretty..."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Shut up! Enough! I don't need this! If no
one is
going to see me for who I am...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Then I don't need them! Just stop
getting in the
way of my running!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Aaaahhhh!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Frick, I'm tired!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Way to drain me of energy right before
a race!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: Had your fill of running yet?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: No... way.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I can't. I can't end it here.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: It's exhausting, annoying, and painful...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: But I don't want to quit. I want to run.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I want to run, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's only one reason why Gold City runs—because she wants to.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rebellious teen or not, the choices she
makes are
unmistakably her own.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It feels like such a childish reason to
run... What if
I get hit with the
"unbeautiful" again?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: You look so beautiful right now.
You look truly beautiful right now.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Didn't I tell you to stop calling me
that?
choice_data_list: No one who sees you run like that ...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
If you're the one saying it... it's not so
bad.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her shy smile glows brightly beneath the
sunset.
